perks.name: Opening Act
perks.description: Final blows with grenades grant Heat weapons bonus stability and vent speed and grant Primary ammo weapons bonus stability and reload speed.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Grenade Kill:
Grants Opening Act for 15 seconds.

Opening Act | +? Stability and +? Vent Speed to Heat Weapons. Primary Weapons are instead granted +? Stability and +? Reload Speed.

perks.name: Room Clearing
perks.description: Multiple final blows with Heat weapons or Primary ammo weapons grant bonuses to weapon and grenade stats and increased ammo generation for Heat weapons and Primary ammo weapons.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring 3 Heat Weapons or Primary Weapon Kills within 4 seconds of each:
Grants Room Cleaning for 10 seconds.

Room Cleaning | +40 Grenade and +40 Weapons. Additionally, it grants +40 Ammo Generation for Heat Weapons and Primary Ammo Weapons.
